description: Local tool and MCP server that builds mobile SDK demo apps and SDK packages (Android Gradle, iOS Xcode, Flutter, React Native) from YAML recipes and publishes them to a synced shared folder, Google Play internal testing and TestFlight.
rules: Recipes in recipes/sdks.yaml use paths relative to the SDK checkout; absolute paths go only in user settings (~/.config/sdk-release-kit/).
Never put passwords or tokens in YAML; keys.yaml holds file paths and SecretRef entries ({source: keychain|env, name}).
Put team-specific identifiers (bundle ids, Apple team id) in custom.yaml and reference them in recipes as ${custom.key:-default}.
Run `sdk-release-kit build --dry-run` (or the plan_build MCP tool) before a real build.
Add a new SDK by adding a recipe with existing step types (run, gradle, flutter, xcode-simulator, xcode-ipa, xcframework, npm-pack, source-zip); no code change needed.
Store uploads soft-skip when credentials are missing; a run only fails on build errors or failed uploads.
